newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton production levels at record level.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton production levels at record level.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp said Monday record production levels, with 16 successful wells drilled to date on Phase I of an extensive three-dimensional seismic program.

It said production levels have more than tripled from this district since September 30, 1996. Of the 16 wells, 11 are on production at a combined rate of 1,912 barrels of oil and 10.3 million cubic feet of gas per day.
Hugoton said the remaining five wells will be placed on production in early February.
Hugoton is an independent oil and natural gas exploration and development company.
